data.description: The Fun Rider is a horse-rider machine with an orange seat and handlebar. The user sits, pushes with the feet and pulls the handlebar at the same time, rising and lowering in a rowing-like motion. It works the arms, back and legs together, so one machine covers a lot of the body. Users of most ages can manage it because they set their own pace. The Fun Rider comes in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness outdoor gym range. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. Our sales team will confirm the Fun Rider's warranty; our standard cover is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to include it in your park or society layout.

items.pText: The Fun Rider is a horse-rider machine with an orange seat and handlebar. The user sits, pushes with the feet and pulls the handlebar at the same time, rising and lowering in a rowing-like motion. It works the arms, back and legs together, so one machine covers a lot of the body. Users of most ages can manage it because they set their own pace. The Fun Rider comes in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness outdoor gym range. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. Our sales team will confirm the Fun Rider's warranty; our standard cover is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to include it in your park or society layout.

The Fun Rider has several linked pivots between the seat, footrests and handlebar, so check each joint and bearing for looseness at every service. Installation is self-standing or grouted, chosen after we see your ground. Keep space behind the seat clear, because the seat arm moves as the user rides.
